title: Review Verdict
description: One verdict file per required review lens, stored under .agent/runs/<TASK-ID>/reviews/<lens>.json or with mission artifacts (spec F.8, Appendix B). Normative example: spec F.8 architecture verdict.

lens.description: Review lens name. Code review lenses are spec/quality/architecture/security (policies/risk.yaml required_review_lenses, spec §10.4/§10.5); project-definition uses a different lens set (intent/coverage, research grounding, architecture, ambiguity per F.8). Left open-ended here since both families of lens names are valid.

artifact.description: The reviewed artifact, e.g. a diff, project-spec.md, or a candidate change (spec F.8).

verdict.description: Each mandatory lens returns PASS/FAIL with findings (spec F.8 Done means).

findings.description: Findings citing the reviewed artifact, source evidence, spec lines, or decision_refs — never taste alone (spec F.8). May be empty on PASS.

kind.description: Finding category, e.g. unsupported-design-claim (spec F.8 example).

ref.description: Cited source, e.g. an ADR id (spec F.8 example).

location.description: Location within the reviewed artifact, e.g. project-spec.md#account-deletion (spec F.8 example).

reviewer.description: Reviewer binding id, e.g. arch-reviewer-02 (spec F.8). Reviewer must be decorrelated from the implementer (spec §10.3 Judge decorrelation, §10.4).
